en_title: Dan Houser Was Surprised ‘How Angry Some People Were’ At Red Dead Redemption’s Iconic Ending
cn_title: 《荒野大镖客：救赎》编剧惊讶玩家怒火
subtitle: 主角之死，难下的决定
opus_summary: 《荒野大镖客：救赎》编剧Dan Houser坦言，部分玩家对结局的愤怒让他意外。团队曾担心主角死后游戏能否正常运作，但他仍认为，主角必须死，故事才有分量。

paragraphs.en: Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption and Red Dead Redemption 2 follow.
paragraphs.cn: 下文涉及《荒野大镖客：救赎》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》剧透。

paragraphs.en: The ending of 2010’s Red Dead Redemption is an all-timer. For dozens of hours, we’re placed in control of protagonist, John Marston, as he wanders across the American West in search of revenge against his former gang leader, Dutch Van der Linde. He, of course, gets it in a snowy showdown in one of its final missions. But John doesn’t get to live out his life in peace. That would be far too tidy an ending. Instead, the outlaw is gunned down by members of the army at his family farm’s barn.
paragraphs.cn: 2010年发售的《荒野大镖客：救赎》有着堪称经典的结局。在数十个小时里，我们操控主角约翰·马斯顿穿行于美国西部，寻找昔日的帮派首领达奇·范德林德，向他复仇。当然，在接近尾声的一场雪地对决中，约翰如愿以偿。但约翰并没有就此过上平静的生活。那样的结局未免太圆满了。这名亡命之徒最终在自家农场的谷仓前遭到军人枪杀。

paragraphs.en: It was a novel twist at the time. Open-world games, and games in general, didn’t do this. It initially split opinion, but has since gone down as a masterstroke in narrative design. Dan Houser, former VP of Rockstar and writer of Red Dead Redemption, recently spoke with IGN as part of our IGN30 Icons Series, and told us that it was just as difficult a decision to make as it sounds.
paragraphs.cn: 这在当时是个新颖的转折。开放世界游戏乃至游戏整体，都没有这样做过。这个结局起初引发了分歧，但后来被视为叙事设计上的神来之笔。Rockstar前副总裁、《荒野大镖客：救赎》编剧Dan Houser近日接受了IGN的采访，这是IGN30 Icons系列的一部分。他告诉我们，做出这个决定确实如听起来那样艰难。

paragraphs.en: “I remember discussing it with the lead designer, Christian Cantamessa, and he was into it, and I was into it, but just knowing the production realities of… how does an open-world game work if you've killed the protagonist? So I said, ‘I think maybe we have to kill him.’ And he goes, ‘That's a great idea. Got to do it.’ I said, ‘I don't know if... let me just think about this,’ because we're just dealing with audio and dialogue. The nature of an open-world game is you finish a story, then you go back into the world and wrap up all the side content if you want to. We'd have to play as someone else for that. We could play as Jack, but what does that mean? So I had to think through for a while what it would mean production-wise.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我记得曾和首席设计师Christian Cantamessa讨论过这件事。他很赞成，我也很赞成，但我们也清楚实际制作会遇到的问题……主角死了，开放世界游戏还怎么运作？于是我说：「我觉得也许我们得让他死。」他说：「这主意太棒了。必须这么做。」我说：「我不知道能不能……让我再想想。」因为光是音频和对话就有问题要处理。开放世界游戏的特点是，玩家完成主线故事后，还能回到游戏世界里，按自己的意愿完成剩余的支线内容。为此，我们得换一个角色来操控。我们可以操控杰克，但这样做会带来哪些问题？所以我得花一段时间想清楚，这会给制作带来什么影响。」

paragraphs.en: Jack is John’s son, and is only 16 years old for the majority of Red Dead Redemption’s runtime. For that transition of control to work, and for the game’s world to make sense, he’d need to become an adult, hence the three-year time jump to 1914 that sees us play as a 19-year-old Jack after his father’s death. But that was just one of the hurdles that faced Houser, Cantamessa, and the team at Rockstar.
paragraphs.cn: 杰克是约翰的儿子，在《荒野大镖客：救赎》的大部分流程中，他只有16岁。要让玩家顺利改为操控他，也让游戏世界合乎情理，他就需要成年。因此，游戏时间向后跳了三年，来到1914年，让我们在约翰死后操控19岁的杰克。但这只是Houser、Cantamessa和Rockstar团队面临的难题之一。

paragraphs.en: “Did we have the skills and the bandwidth to play as Jack?” Houser recalled questioning. “Would it work? Technically, not story-wise. We'll figure out the story aspect. If you go and see a side character and they've got a three-mission arc and you've already done one mission, what would that actually mean if you came back? How would that work? We had to think through all of that stuff and concluded we could probably make it work, but we were still scared.”
paragraphs.cn: Houser回忆，自己当时曾问：「我们有没有足够的技术能力和精力，让玩家操控杰克？这样能行吗？我说的是技术上，不是故事上。故事方面我们会想办法。如果你去见一个支线角色，对方有一条包含三个任务的故事线，而你已经完成了其中一个，那么换了主角再回来，具体会遇到什么情况？这该怎么处理？这些问题我们都得想清楚，最后认为应该能做成，但我们还是很忐忑。」

paragraphs.en: The final story mission of the 2010 masterpiece sees Jack carry out his own act of cathartic revenge when he kills the person responsible for John’s murder in a duel. It’s the moment that makes it all work and ties the knot on the game’s story.
paragraphs.cn: 在这部2010年杰作的最后一个主线任务中，杰克在决斗中杀死了谋害约翰的罪魁祸首，完成了自己的复仇，也宣泄了情绪。正是这一刻，让整个故事成立，也为游戏的故事画上了句号。

paragraphs.en: “I think people really loved that moment when you killed them and found it so powerful internally,” Houser said. “I think there was broad consensus that it was the right decision, but obviously it was an unusual and out-there decision, but I think the company had survived on making those decisions. I think we were surprised when the game came out by how angry some people were about that decision. There were people who were livid with you. And part of you goes, ‘That's fantastic,’ because it means you've really engaged in the story and the characters.
paragraphs.cn: Houser说：「我想，大家真的很喜欢你杀死他们的那一刻，团队内部也觉得这一幕很有力量。我想，大家普遍认同这个决定是对的，但显然，这个决定很不寻常，也很大胆。不过我觉得，公司一直以来就是靠做出这样的决定生存下来的。游戏发售后，有些人对这个决定如此愤怒，让我们有些意外。有些人对我们怒不可遏。你心里有一部分会觉得，这太棒了，因为这说明你真的投入到了故事和角色之中。」

paragraphs.en: Another part was like, you forget, or I can forget sometimes, we're not making movies, we're not writing books, we're making games. The game can't live without a player. So they do feel ownership over what you and they are co-creating in the moment in a way someone looking at a painting, say, doesn't. And I think they felt really let down by this decision.
paragraphs.cn: 「但心里另一部分又会想，你会忘记，或者说，我有时候会忘记，我们不是在拍电影，也不是在写书，而是在做游戏。没有玩家，游戏就无法存在。所以，玩家会觉得，你和他们在游玩过程中共同创造的东西，也有他们的一份；而比如说，欣赏一幅画的人就不会有这种感受。我想，他们觉得这个决定真的让他们很失望。」

paragraphs.en: “Now, I think it was the right decision because you want those big, strong reactions, but I think people were really confused by it. As a writer, it was like he had to die for the story to have any weight, and I had wanted that in several GTAs. We’d never done it really for the technical reasons we just discussed.”
paragraphs.cn: 「现在，我认为这个决定是对的，因为你就是希望引起这样强烈的反应，但我觉得大家当时真的很困惑。作为编剧，我觉得他必须死，故事才会有分量。我也曾希望在好几部《GTA》作品中这样处理。我们一直没真正这么做，是因为刚才谈到的那些技术原因。」

paragraphs.en: Houser seemingly enjoyed it so much that a similar trick was pulled in its sequel, Red Dead Redemption 2, this time arguably to even greater effect as the prequel bound us to Arthur Morgan before Marston once again took over the reins.
paragraphs.cn: Houser似乎很喜欢这种处理方式，以至于续作《荒野大镖客：救赎2》也用了类似的手法。这次的效果可以说更胜一筹：这部前传先让我们与亚瑟·摩根建立起情感联系，再让马斯顿重新接棒。

paragraphs.en: In a post-RDR2 world, Rockstar will once again be looking to push its storytelling capabilities forward in GTA 6 by letting us play as a couple on the run, Jason and Lucia. Will we still be able to play as both of them by the time the credits roll?
paragraphs.cn: 在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》之后，Rockstar将再次尝试通过《GTA6》提升叙事水平，让我们扮演一对逃亡中的情侣——杰森和露西亚。等到片尾字幕滚动时，我们还能继续操控他们两人吗？

paragraphs.en: For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《GTA6》的消息，可以阅读我们对Rockstar工作室联席负责人Rob Nelson的完整采访，以及关于这款游戏将如何应对当前政治氛围、Dan Houser为何表示自己不会玩这款游戏的报道。
